title: Dairy Campus Research Data Platform: Metadata Dictionary, Extraction Queries, and Calculation Models
description:
This repository provides the comprehensive FAIR metadata specification, standardized data dictionaries, data extraction queries, and data processing calculation models for the Dairy Campus research facility (Wageningen University & Research, Leeuwarden, the Netherlands).

Dairy Campus operates a high-resolution, multi-sensor experimental dairy cattle infrastructure. The repository contains:

  • Data Dictionaries (English): Detailed variable-level definitions, measurement units, data types, and provenance for 19 core research datasets (including daily summaries, roughage intake, concentrate feeding, milking, emissions, rumination/activity behavior, and barn climate).
  • Research Report Extraction Queries: Standardized SQL extraction queries (used in automated Apache Airflow pipelines) parameterized by experiment/trial code ([prfcod]).
  • Calculation Models & Provenance: Stored procedures, views, and functions that compute derived parameters, including fresh-to-dry-matter roughage intake conversions, mixer wagon added water subtractions, milk composition metrics, behavioral durations, and missing data quality flags.
